limitations: The theorem is restricted to discrete underlying topology, does not settle the Borel status of the full rigid locus, and the explicit hole constants are not claimed optimal. For cardinality at most the continuum, prior strong-rigidity results already imply bare density; the new content there is the quantitative rigid-subball property.
provenance: Scientific sources and audit evidence are listed in RESULT.md, REVIEW.md, and the independent-audit files dated 2026-10-01.
record_title: Uniform rigid holes in the space of metrics on every discrete set
